description.text: We are the leading mobile telecommunications company in Brazil (with a 38.1% market share as of December 31, 2025, based on accesses), with a particularly strong position in postpaid mobile services (40.3% market share as of December 31, 2025, based on accesses). Our Vivo brand, under which we market our services, is among the most recognized brands in Brazil. The quality of our services and the strength of our brand recognition enable us to sustain this market leadership. We offer our clients a complete portfolio of products, including mobile and fixed-line voice, mobile data, fixed broadband, ultra-fast broadband, or UBB (based on our FTTH and FTTC infrastructure), Pay TV, information technology and digital services (such as entertainment, cloud, security and financial services). We also have one of the most extensive distribution networks in the sector, where our clients can obtain certain services, such as purchasing credit for prepaid phones. We seek to continue to increase our operating margins by focusing on developing and growing our product offerings so that they comprise an integrated portfolio that allows us to extend our customers' lifetime value.

The firm is strongest in the postpaid business, where it has 50 million customers, about 37% share of this market. It is the incumbent fixed-line telephone operator in Sao Paulo state and, following the acquisition of GVT, the owner of an extensive fiber network across the country. The firm provides internet access to 6 million households on this network. Following its parent Telefonica's footsteps, Vivo is cross-selling fixed-line and wireless services as a converged offering. The firm also sells pay-tv services to its fixed-line customers.

# VIV — TELEFONICA BRASIL S.A. (Telefônica Brasil / Vivo)
v5 run, 2026-10-16. All figures below are copied from dcf_numbers.json, financials_history.csv, or ttm.py output — none are recomputed. Interim-print figures are from the company's filed 6-K earnings releases as summarized in search results, cited where used.

## What it is
Brazil's incumbent-scale telecom operator, trading as Vivo: the country's largest wireless carrier (about 33% market share, postpaid leadership at about 37% of postpaid), plus FTTH broadband, fixed voice and corporate data/ICT across Brazil. Controlled by Telefónica S.A. (77.13% direct/indirect interest at March 31, 2026, per the Q1 2026 6-K). Files on Form 20-F under IFRS, reports in BRL. NYSE ADS (ticker VIV); B3 listing VIVT3.

## Owner's earnings
**FY2025 (20-F via EDGAR, from financials_history.csv, USD after FX conversion):** operating cash flow $3,782,168,909.12; capex $1,726,571,605.92 (tag: PurchaseOfPropertyPlantAndEquipmentClassifiedAsInvestingActivities); SBC $9,820,267.52 (tag: ExpenseFromSharebasedPaymentTransactionsWithEmployees — SBC is always a real cost; here it is negligible either way); net income $1,127,772,250.08; D&A $2,728,250,394.24.
- **Conservative owner's earnings FY2025: $2,045,777,035.68** (OCF − capex − SBC). OE positive 5 of the last 5 fiscal years.
- Maintenance version (NI + D&A − min(capex, D&A) − ΔNWC): $2,102,693,492.58 for FY2025 — same ballpark as the conservative figure.
